comment: Frozen oracle bundle for the native recipe hooks runner (GO-20 U2e T5 PR2-B S9). Captured once from the live Python 3.14.7 oracle (testdata/hooksrunner_ref.py driving lib/_internal/recipe-materialize.py execute_hooks) through the same in-package helpers the live differential used, twice with fresh roots and byte-identical records. Frozen properties: the raised error string, stdout, stderr and the bootstrap-board marker bytes (absent when the oracle wrote none). No host path appears in any frozen string, so no token is needed. Restore from a pristine copy, never re-encode.
